summary: Structure trusted knowledge bases with ownership, provenance, and review cycles.
intents: set up an owner and review cycle for internal docs
find and fix stale pages in the knowledge base
design a taxonomy for our help articles
migrate notes into a structured knowledge base
not_for: standalone public blog writing without knowledge-base design or governance
isolated meeting-note summaries without knowledge architecture or retrieval needs
prerequisites: knowledge sources and intended users or workflows
available repository, wiki, or document-management capabilities
content ownership, access rules, and retention requirements where known

verify.description: No broken links in the reviewed pages

verify: Every page has an owner and a last-reviewed date
